title: Page 385
transc:

cause you anxiety or prevent you from flooding
time of your lurk or trip as orphan

replied not anything blue hoped you would remain
& enjoy the rest as long as you
pleased purple I leveled letter nautical from Prescott
Smith Parker house Tragedy who desires a Kindle
to visit usual & see insanity Stephens first
that he had mentioned the subject to you
had your consent and C Carmine If so
will you issue the Justify or end me
Silver Galway Towns End asks for reply to
his music sent you in reference to Cadets
at Welch Copper Hatch message from inspect Hutchinson
saying all well Chicken Cottage Red nothing Godfrey
chicken Egypt Master Regent are you homesick yet
